title: test(spec): metadata-type-schemas.test.ts pins the registry at `closed 27 / types 28` and is bumped on every new metadata kind — state the rule in words, drop the counts
body:
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Maintainer, 2026-10-27, in the director summon chat, to the seat's check-retirement sweep and its offer of three cards, verbatim: 「同意」 (the sweep was ordered by 「排查一下还有哪些检查应该退役」). Filed by the director seat (`session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708, sweep record 6433263738). ⛔ Not a claim. Batch-of: 11 (director seat, 2026-10-27). Dedupe: 600 newest open + closed issues grepped for the check's file name → 0 unless stated. Part of #26431. Reader: `domain:spec`.

**Measured:** `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-schemas.test.ts:656–657` — `expect(closed.length).toBe(27); expect(types.length).toBe(28);` with a comment log of each bump (25→26 picklist, 26→27, 27→28 sharing_rule on 2026-10-19). The invariant the file protects is stated two lines above the numbers: every registered type's authoring schema is closed (`.strict()`) except `view`.

**Wanted:** replace the two counts with the rule — the set of types whose schema is not closed equals `['view']` (or whatever the file names), computed from the registry; keep `types.length > 0`. The bump log moves to the file header as history. **Acceptance:** adding a closed metadata kind changes no test; `git grep -n "closed.length).toBe(" packages/spec` → 0. **Size:** XS. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.
